# `raptorbt.structures`

Declarative multi-leg option structures, resolved against an ``OptionChain`` at the event time
and placed as one group of linked orders. See ``docs/structures.md``.

| Name | Kind | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`Atm`](#atm) | function | The money strike: ``Steps(0)``. |
| [`Delta`](#delta) | class | The listed contract of the leg's right whose delta is nearest ``target`` in magnitude (0.25 picks a 25-delta call or put), priced at a flat ``vol`` at the event time, on the leg's own expiry. Ties go to the lower strike (``OptionChain.by_delta``). |
| [`Exit`](#exit) | class | When to close the whole group. Every field is optional; the first that fires wins. |
| [`Expiry`](#expiry) | class | Which listed expiry, as ``OptionChain.pick_expiry`` reads it at the event time. |
| [`Leg`](#leg) | class | One option leg: ``ratio`` lots of the contract ``strike`` and ``expiry`` pick, per lot of the structure. |
| [`LegState`](#legstate) | class | LegState(index: 'int', client_id: 'str', leg: 'ResolvedLeg', orders: 'list[str]' = <factory>, sent: 'float' = 0.0, filled: 'float' = 0.0, cost: 'float' = 0.0, cancelled: 'set[str]' = <factory>, close_ids: 'list[str]' = <factory>, requested: 'dict[str, float]' = <factory>, got: 'dict[str, float]' = <factory>, close_failed: 'set[str]' = <factory>, retry_after_ns: 'int \| None' = None) |
| [`Premium`](#premium) | class | The contract whose ``measure(spec)`` is nearest ``target`` (a quoted premium, say); contracts for which it returns ``None`` or NaN are skipped (``OptionChain.closest_by``). |
| [`ResolvedLeg`](#resolvedleg) | class | A leg bound to a listed contract, with its size. |
| [`ResolvedStructure`](#resolvedstructure) | class | A structure bound to contracts at one event time. Leg order is the template's. |
| [`Steps`](#steps) | class | ``n`` strikes from the money strike on the structure's anchor ladder, up positive. |
| [`Strike`](#strike) | class | An explicit strike value; the leg's expiry must list it. |
| [`Structure`](#structure) | class | A declarative multi-leg position: legs with strike and expiry selectors, no contracts yet. |
| [`StructureBook`](#structurebook) | class | The groups one strategy has placed in one run. |
| [`StructureGroup`](#structuregroup) | class | The handle ``submit_structure`` returns. Read ``status`` / ``reason`` / ``failure``; do not mutate. |
| [`UnderlyingLeg`](#underlyingleg) | class | Shares (or the underlying instrument) held against the options: ``ratio`` option lots' worth of units per lot of the structure. The units must be a multiple of the underlying's lot size. |
| [`bear_call_spread`](#bear_call_spread) | function | Credit: sell the call ``short_steps`` up, buy the call ``long_steps`` up. |
| [`bear_put_spread`](#bear_put_spread) | function | Debit: buy the put ``long_steps`` down, sell the put ``short_steps`` down. |
| [`bull_call_spread`](#bull_call_spread) | function | Debit: buy the call ``long_steps`` up, sell the call ``short_steps`` up. |
| [`bull_put_spread`](#bull_put_spread) | function | Credit: sell the put ``short_steps`` down, buy the put ``long_steps`` down. |
| [`butterfly`](#butterfly) | function | ``side`` one wing, opposite two at the money, ``side`` the other wing, ``wing_steps`` apart. |
| [`calendar`](#calendar) | function | Sell the contract ``steps`` out at the near expiry, buy the same strike at the far one (default: the first and second listed expiries). Refused when the far expiry does not list the strike. |
| [`collar`](#collar) | function | Long the underlying, long the put ``put_steps`` down, short the call ``call_steps`` up. |
| [`condor`](#condor) | function | In one right: ``side`` the outer strikes, the opposite the inner ones, symmetric about the money. |
| [`covered_call`](#covered_call) | function | Long the underlying, short the call ``call_steps`` up. Needs ``underlying_spec`` on resolve. |
| [`iron_butterfly`](#iron_butterfly) | function | ``side="sell"``: sell the money call and put, buy a call and a put ``wing_steps`` out. |
| [`iron_condor`](#iron_condor) | function | ``side="sell"`` (the usual): sell the put ``inner_steps`` down and the call ``inner_steps`` up, buy those ``outer_steps`` out. ``"buy"`` is the reverse. |
| [`protective_put`](#protective_put) | function | Long the underlying, long the put ``put_steps`` down. |
| [`ratio_spread`](#ratio_spread) | function | Buy ``long_ratio`` lots ``long_steps`` out, sell ``short_ratio`` lots ``short_steps`` out. The default is a front (1x2) spread; ``long_ratio > short_ratio`` is a back spread. |
| [`risk_reversal`](#risk_reversal) | function | ``side="buy"``: buy the call ``steps`` up, sell the put ``steps`` down. |
| [`straddle`](#straddle) | function | The money call and put, both ``side``. |
| [`strangle`](#strangle) | function | The call ``steps`` up and the put ``steps`` down, both ``side``. |
| [`strangle_by_delta`](#strangle_by_delta) | function | A strangle whose call and put are the contracts nearest ``delta`` in magnitude. |
| [`vertical`](#vertical) | function | Buy the contract ``long_steps`` out and sell the one ``short_steps`` out. ``long_steps < short_steps`` is a debit spread. |

### `Exit`

*class*

```python
class Exit
Exit(stop_loss: 'float | None' = None, take_profit: 'float | None' = None, premium_at_or_above: 'float | None' = None, premium_at_or_below: 'float | None' = None, close_at_ns: 'int | None' = None, days_before_expiry: 'float | None' = None, entry_timeout_ns: 'int | None' = None) -> None
```

When to close the whole group. Every field is optional; the first that fires wins.

``stop_loss`` / ``take_profit``: net P&L of the legs against their fill prices, in currency
(positive numbers; costs excluded), checked once every leg has filled.
``premium_at_or_above`` / ``premium_at_or_below``: the net premium of one lot at the marks
(see ``ResolvedStructure.net_premium``), checked once every leg has filled.
``close_at_ns``: close at or after this time, whatever has filled.
``days_before_expiry``: close this many days before the earliest option expiry.
``entry_timeout_ns``: unwind if the legs have not all filled this long after submission.

| --- | --- |

### `Steps`

*class*

```python
class Steps
Steps(n: 'int' = 0) -> None
```

``n`` strikes from the money strike on the structure's anchor ladder, up positive.

The money strike is the listed strike nearest the spot (the lower on a tie); the anchor
ladder is the strikes of the structure's earliest expiry. A leg at a later expiry takes the
same strike value there and is refused if that expiry does not list it.

| Member | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `n` | *No docstring.* |

### `Structure`

*class*

```python
class Structure
Structure(legs: 'tuple[Leg | UnderlyingLeg, ...]', name: 'str' = 'custom') -> None
```

A declarative multi-leg position: legs with strike and expiry selectors, no contracts yet.

``resolve`` binds it to the chain at an event time (``now_ns``); nothing listed after that
time is visible. Use the factories (``straddle``, ``iron_condor``, ...) or build one from legs.

| Member | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `name` | *No docstring.* |
| `resolve(self, chain: "'OptionChain'", underlying: 'str', spot: 'float', now_ns: 'int', lots: 'int' = 1, *, underlying_spec: "'InstrumentSpec | None'" = None) -> 'ResolvedStructure'` | Bind to contracts and sizes. ``lots`` of the structure; a leg's lots are ``ratio x lots``. An ``UnderlyingLeg`` needs ``underlying_spec``. |

### `StructureBook`

*class*

```python
class StructureBook
StructureBook(strategy: "'Strategy'") -> 'None'
```

The groups one strategy has placed in one run.

| Member | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `close(self, group: 'StructureGroup', reason: 'str' = 'manual') -> 'None'` | Start closing the group: cancel what works, close what filled. |
| `on_event(self, event, now_ns: 'int') -> 'None'` | An order event: book a fill against its leg, then run the group's lifecycle in the same step (release the sold legs the hedges now cover, or start the close). |
| `submit(self, structure: 'Structure | ResolvedStructure', *, now_ns: 'int', chain=None, underlying: 'str | None' = None, spot: 'float | None' = None, lots: 'int' = 1, underlying_spec=None, order_type: 'str' = 'market', prices: 'Mapping[str, float] | None' = None, net_limit: 'float | None' = None, exit: 'Exit | None' = None, on_leg_failure: 'str' = 'unwind', margin_model=None, available: 'float | None' = None, tif: 'str' = 'auto', group_id: 'str | None' = None) -> 'StructureGroup'` | *No docstring.* |
| `update(self, now_ns: 'int', marks: 'Mapping[str, float] | None' = None, *, exits: 'bool' = True) -> 'list[StructureGroup]'` | Advance every group: leg-failure policy, exits, the sold legs the hedges cover and the pending cancels and closes. Returns the groups that began closing. ``exits=False`` runs only the lifecycle (leg failure, entry timeout and the pump), which needs no marks. |
